purpose: Evaluate one state-driven operational proxy after V6 passed both rank gates at high load but concentrated placements too early at low and middle load.

diagnostic_basis.diagnosis: V6 concentration is beneficial once backlog is heavy but harmful when parallel cold-start and headroom benefits still dominate. V7 fixes two per-node runnable-queue thresholds, 32 and 96, before running a new seed. Sparse windows consume each idle function worker once as Hiku-P does; moderate windows use the published Orion-P placement score with same-window parent locality; heavily backlogged windows retain V6. The runtime classifier reads only the current pending+runnable queue and node count, never a workload label or completed-request outcome.

regimes.proxy: one-shot Hiku-P idle function worker, then running/starting/absent container rank and least-connected fallback
Orion-P: 0.40 resource headroom + 0.30 warm affinity + 0.20 inverse task load + 0.10 actual-and-same-window parent locality
V6: 0.425 warm + 0.30 headroom + 0.175 inverse task load + 0.05 parent locality + 0.05 bounded placement affinity

candidate.player_order: request_id ascending, then Orion critical-path rank descending, then function_id ascending

eligibility: all nine reference builds and online runs pass protocol QC and result-blind pairing
for every load, geometric-mean throughput and QPR ratios versus first-version NSESche are each at least 0.98
overall geometric-mean latency and cost ratios versus first-version NSESche are each at most 1.10
for every load, mean throughput and mean QPR each rank first against the frozen E01-E03 baselines
screen.selection_rule: the sole candidate either passes every gate or V7 stops without opening confirmation

confirmation.closure_requirement: For every load, optimized NSESche must rank first in mean fixed-window throughput and mean QPR against the frozen E11-E20 baselines; otherwise report not closed without seed deletion.
confirmation.post_confirmation: Only after confirmation passes may the frozen optimized NSESche be rerun on E01-E10 for a descriptive 20-seed table; E11-E20 remains the independent confirmatory block.
